title: Removal-of-luck panel: skill vs luck decomposed, ranked on skill only
method: Signal (accuracy vs 0.500, placebo) is separated from staking (assumed-price ROI). The leaderboard ranks on signal tier; staking is reported but never promotes a strategy and pays no points on assumed prices (amendment A1).
panel: A1: points require verified prices (G7); G7 blocked (FB-01)

rows.decomposition: skill = signal accuracy vs 0.500 + placebo; luck = staking-ROI variance not explained by signal
rows.verdict: luck removed: ranked on signal tier only; staking ROI reported separately and never used to rank
